brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to forecast hourly bike demand, and cnt is the single numeric count of total rentals per hour, so a regression task on cnt is the defensible main study; casual and registered are the components that sum to cnt and must not be features, and instant is a row key. Rows are consecutive hourly periods of one series, so dteday plus hr supply chronology for time-respecting splits and no group column is needed; the workflow default metric is retained.
brief.repeated_subjects: None: one continuous series, with repeated hourly rows per calendar day rather than repeated independent subjects
brief.unit: One hourly bike-rental record (a single clock hour of the rental system, 24 records per calendar day)
